sku_gin_london_dry.name: 伦敦干金酒
sku_gin_london_dry.visual_hint: Colorless transparent spirit; juniper flavor does not authorize green liquid, berries, herbs or extra garnish.

sku_green_chartreuse.name: 绿查特酒
sku_green_chartreuse.visual_hint: Muted yellow-green herbal liqueur; contributes a soft jade tint, never fluorescent green and no visible herbs unless separately listed.

sku_maraschino.name: 马拉斯奇诺樱桃利口酒
sku_maraschino.visual_hint: Nearly colorless transparent cherry liqueur; cherry flavor does not make the liquid red or authorize a cherry garnish.

sku_lime_juice.name: 鲜榨青柠汁
sku_lime_juice.visual_hint: Pale yellow-green juice with mild citrus haze; juice alone does not authorize lime wedges, wheels or chunks; pulp depends on preparation.

sku_lime_wedge.name: 青柠角
sku_lime_wedge.visual_hint: A lime wedge with green rind and pale yellow-green flesh; show only the actual selected count and placement, not an additional wheel.

sku_lemon_juice.name: 鲜榨柠檬汁
sku_lemon_juice.visual_hint: Pale straw-yellow citrus juice, mildly cloudy; do not add lemon slices unless separately selected as garnish.

sku_lemon_slice.name: 柠檬片
sku_lemon_slice.visual_hint: Thin lemon slice with yellow peel and translucent pale flesh; only selected slices appear, with no automatic extra citrus garnish.

sku_tonic_water.name: 汤力水
sku_tonic_water.visual_hint: Colorless transparent mixer with fine carbonation bubbles; bitterness does not make the liquid brown or green.

sku_white_rum.name: 白朗姆酒
sku_white_rum.visual_hint: Nearly colorless transparent white rum; do not add amber aging color or a garnish solely from the ingredient name.

sku_mint_sprig.name: 薄荷枝
sku_mint_sprig.visual_hint: Fresh green mint sprig; one sprig is a small connected stem with several leaves, not one isolated leaf; only show actual garnish count.

sku_white_cane_sugar.name: 白蔗糖
sku_white_cane_sugar.visual_hint: White cane sugar crystals; normally dissolved during preparation, not a powder mound or sugar rim; show solid sugar only if explicitly retained.

sku_soda_water.name: 苏打水
sku_soda_water.visual_hint: Colorless transparent soda with small bubbles; no intrinsic green or amber tint and no automatic fruit garnish.

sku_vodka.name: 伏特加
sku_vodka.visual_hint: Colorless transparent spirit; vodka alone does not add visible color, foam, fruit or garnish.

sku_tequila.name: 龙舌兰酒
sku_tequila.visual_hint: Use a neutral nearly clear to faint straw game-art placeholder because the source does not select a tequila variety; no automatic salt rim or lime.

sku_cointreau.name: 君度橙酒
sku_cointreau.visual_hint: Nearly colorless transparent orange liqueur; orange aroma does not imply orange-colored liquid or an orange peel garnish.

sku_simple_syrup.name: 糖浆
sku_simple_syrup.visual_hint: Clear to faint straw syrup once mixed; no visible sugar crystals, syrup layer or sugar rim unless explicitly requested by preparation.

sku_cola.name: 可乐
sku_cola.visual_hint: Translucent deep brown carbonated mixer; dilution makes a warmer lighter amber-brown drink; do not show an opaque black block.

sku_rye_whiskey.name: 黑麦威士忌
sku_rye_whiskey.visual_hint: Transparent warm amber rye whiskey; only a liquid contribution, not a whiskey bottle, grain decoration or automatic ice.

sku_sweet_red_vermouth.name: 甜红味美思
sku_sweet_red_vermouth.visual_hint: Translucent red-brown sweet vermouth; contributes muted ruby and reddish amber tones without adding fruit or herb pieces.

sku_angostura_bitters.name: 安格仕苦精
sku_angostura_bitters.visual_hint: Dark red-brown bitters used in a small dash; do not invent dash-to-ml conversion or turn a whole drink dark solely from one dash.

sku_cocktail_cherry.name: 鸡尾酒樱桃
sku_cocktail_cherry.visual_hint: Dark red cocktail cherries; show exactly the quantity selected in the target recipe, whether one, two or more. Do not infer additional cherries, garnish picks, stems or citrus.

sku_mint_leaf.name: 薄荷叶
sku_mint_leaf.visual_hint: Separate fresh green mint leaves; visible in the drink only when retained_solids says they remain; pressed leaves are not a garnish sprig.
